summary: HelioHealth: EU-only data residency - confirm support access model + approve exception
description: Customer wants EU-only residency and asked if Redwood support personnel outside EU can access their tenant details during escalations. They will allow audited break-glass access to metadata/audit logs but want explicit documentation and controls.
comments:
[2024-10-02] Evelyn Hart: HelioHealth procurement asks where our support team is located and whether non-EU staff can access anything. They will accept access to audit logs/metadata if we can show break-glass + auditing.

[2024-10-03] Aisha Rahman: We can approve an exception for out-of-region support access to operational metadata only (no payloads). Document as residency exception.

[2024-10-07] Jonas Weber: Confirmed console audit logs are stored in-region (EU) and access is via RBAC. Break-glass role is time-limited.

[2024-10-10] Evelyn Hart: Sent customer confirmation email including: scope (audit logs + request metadata), no prompt/response storage, and break-glass controls.

[2024-10-11] Aisha Rahman: Closing; exception record published.
